expansions.what: transfer action vocabularies and competence ecologies
stronger surface collisions and equifinal histories
additional foraging ecologies and conflict magnitudes

cards.question: Do the V13 numeric anchors used by V14 reproduce from committed inputs?
cards.construction: the committed V13 verdicts V14's design imports (C04, A03, G01, H03, C15, X10) are re-read and hashed; the cited fields compared
cards.estimand: max absolute deviation of cited fields from the committed files

cards.question: Does the manifest enumerate all 64 cards, factors, attacks, lanes, and independent-unit floors?
cards.construction: recursive validation of the manifest against the literal spec inventory
cards.estimand: counts and presence of every required field
cards.alternative_expectation: an omission is a program defect

cards.question: Does the joint enumerator recover exact posteriors in tiny exhaustive worlds and remain invariant to labels/order?
cards.construction: brute-force enumeration against the grid posterior; relabelled actions, tokens and menu options; permuted evidence order
cards.estimand: max deviation from brute force; max change under relabelling and reordering
cards.alternative_expectation: a deviation is a solver bug

cards.question: Are action, semantic, context, and forensic routes independently live and materially different in information?
cards.construction: route-only posteriors on the same episodes; pairwise divergence; a shuffled null route
cards.estimand: pairwise Jensen-Shannon and information per route and latent; null-route information
cards.null_expectation: divergent and informative; null at zero
cards.alternative_expectation: a dead or duplicate route voids R

cards.question: Are surface collisions, equifinal histories, factor orthogonality, and lineage identities valid?
cards.construction: matched-surface pairs hash equal; equivalent (plan, goal) pairs give identical non-forensic likelihoods; one-factor manipulations leak at floor; lanes disjoint
cards.estimand: collision hash equality; likelihood identity; max leak; lineage overlap
cards.alternative_expectation: a leak or overlap voids dependent cards

cards.question: Repair V13 C03 once: within-common versus all-family prior, preserving its target and failed positive gate.
cards.construction: V13's world and priors re-read (read-only); the positive floor derived from the construction's expected gain
cards.estimand: log-score gain of within-common over all-family by dose against the construction floor

cards.question: Repair V13 C05 once: self versus within-common prior, preserving reader-type interaction and convergence placebo.
cards.construction: V13's readers by type; the convergence dose derived from the construction
cards.estimand: self minus within-common by reader type and dose; convergence at the derived dose

cards.question: Repair V13 P01 once: matched-local correction curve, preserving similarity bins, prospective endpoint, and failed calibration record.
cards.construction: V13's matched routes and bins; correction RATE per bin; unit-level calibration at the prospective endpoint
cards.estimand: half-life, residual, correction rate and endpoint calibration by route and bin
cards.alternative_expectation: correction by route with rate ordering

cards.question: Is process identifiable when goal and preference are supplied?
cards.construction: oracle goal and preference; distinct and process-equivalent histories
cards.estimand: class mass and single-state mass by history kind

cards.question: Is episode goal identifiable when process and preference are supplied?
cards.construction: oracle process and preference; the hidden next action within the episode
cards.estimand: next-action log score over the prior by dose

cards.question: Is standing preference identifiable when process and episode goal are supplied across episodes?
cards.construction: oracle process and goals; the next episode's first action after the local goal changed
cards.estimand: next-episode action log score over the prior by episodes seen

cards.question: Does recurrent joint inference beat independent marginals under matched evidence/compute?
cards.construction: five estimators on one likelihood table; held-out next action; calibration; the independent estimator is the cross-latent ablation
cards.estimand: held-out log score by estimator and dose; ECE
cards.closure: close the joint advantage if no estimator beats independent on a prospective target

cards.question: Which staged order is best, and is any order uniformly best across expertise/access regimes?
cards.construction: three orders x three access regimes x two reader competences
cards.estimand: held-out log score by order, regime and competence

cards.question: At what evidence dose does each latent first improve prospective prediction?
cards.construction: trajectories saved after every episode; provisional-confidence curve
cards.estimand: first improving dose per latent; confidence by dose

cards.question: Does diagnostic contradiction revise all affected latents rather than only the surface label?
cards.construction: a planted contradiction after four episodes; a consistent continuation as placebo
cards.estimand: Jensen-Shannon movement per latent after contradiction and after continuation

cards.question: Does the joint reader abstain on exact equifinality and contract uncertainty after resolving evidence?
cards.construction: process-equivalent histories, then a forensic observation
cards.estimand: single-state and class mass before and after resolution; risk-coverage

cards.question: Can it distinguish a changed episode goal from a changed standing preference?
cards.construction: crossed intervention: goal changed, preference changed, neither; held-out future choices
cards.estimand: detection and confusion rates

cards.question: Does the joint advantage transfer to fresh world factorization and action vocabulary?
cards.construction: the frozen estimators on transfer families and vocabularies
cards.estimand: joint minus independent on fresh worlds

cards.question: Which route contains the most target information in each access regime?
cards.construction: exact conditional information per route and latent; the prediction ruler on the dominant route
cards.estimand: information by route, latent and regime

cards.question: Can a reader learn route reliability from feedback without receiving target labels at test?
cards.construction: training makers with feedback; test makers without labels; learned, equal, random and fixed weights
cards.estimand: held-out log score by weighting
cards.closure: close reliable routing if learned never beats equal

cards.question: Does planted ease bias route use when accuracy is equal?
cards.construction: the wrong route made cheap and the right route dear, then reversed; ease-driven and learned readers
cards.estimand: route weight and score by condition and reader
cards.alternative_expectation: ease-driven reader biased; learned reader not

cards.question: Does true accuracy control route use when ease is equal?
cards.construction: equal ease; the accurate route hard or easy; ease-driven and learned readers
cards.estimand: score and weight by condition and reader
cards.alternative_expectation: accuracy decides for the learned reader

cards.question: When routes conflict, does expanding the latent set to missing goal, constraint, or strategic source improve prediction?
cards.construction: consistent and strategic-source worlds; fixed and expanded readers; search cost
cards.estimand: gain minus search cost; false positives in consistent worlds

cards.question: When is costly forensic access worth purchasing?
cards.construction: exact information-per-cost, random, always-buy, never-buy policies
cards.estimand: realized gain per cost by policy

cards.question: Can routes be fused without treating correlated or duplicated evidence as independent?
cards.construction: independent, duplicated and paraphrased semantic evidence; naive and shared-cause fusion
cards.estimand: confidence rise and calibration by evidence kind and fusion

cards.question: Do learned route reliabilities transfer, or should the reader reset under a new domain?
cards.construction: a fresh vocabulary with changed reliabilities; reset, partial, full transfer
cards.estimand: held-out score by transfer kind
cards.alternative_expectation: reset or partial best under change

cards.question: Are demonstrated competence and past attention/value history independently live?
cards.construction: full K x H manipulation; process accuracy and early relevance as the two measures
cards.estimand: each measure by each factor; cross-leak

cards.question: With competence matched, does different attention history change initial route choice or prior?
cards.construction: readers with none or strong stale route history; initial and corrected phases
cards.estimand: route-weight divergence and score gap by phase

cards.question: With history matched, does different competence change process reconstruction?
cards.construction: readers at three competences with the same history
cards.estimand: process prediction and calibration by competence

cards.question: Does a learned attention bias persist after its reward/value reverses?
cards.construction: reward reversal at a planted episode; bias measured at increasing distances
cards.estimand: bias by episodes after reversal; current-utility cost

cards.question: Can target evidence correct stale attention history without erasing genuine skill?
cards.construction: stale-history readers before and after feedback correction; process accuracy retained
cards.estimand: bias reduction and skill retention by phase

cards.question: Does competence selectively improve early relevance detection?
cards.construction: low and high competence makers; relevance detected by dose
cards.estimand: detection gain by competence and dose

cards.question: Does attention history transfer more broadly or narrowly than competence across domains?
cards.construction: history and competence measured in the native and a fresh domain
cards.estimand: cross-domain conditional matrix

cards.question: When skill was acquired through different attention paths, do equal competencies yield different maker signatures?
cards.construction: two acquisition paths at equal competence; held-out early-transition signatures
cards.estimand: signature classifier accuracy; process accuracy gap

cards.question: Can diverse calibrated readers shrink the compatible maker set without naive averaging?
cards.construction: readers with different competence models; average, likelihood intersection, feasible set, best member
cards.estimand: log score and calibration by method

cards.question: Which object - competence, attention history, or current preference - best predicts the maker's next novel choice?
cards.construction: factor interventions; hidden next novel choice; last-choice baseline
cards.estimand: log score by object over baseline
cards.alternative_expectation: one or more beat the baseline

cards.question: Are reader response, intended audience appraisal, maker appraisal, content support, communicative goal, reliability, and uptake independently live?
cards.construction: each owner varied alone; every posterior measured
cards.estimand: own movement and leak per owner

cards.question: When is the reader's own induced response a useful prior for intended audience effect?
cards.construction: reader similar or dissimilar to the audience; projecting and neutral readers
cards.estimand: intended-effect log score by similarity and reader

cards.question: Can intended effect be recovered while maker appraisal remains uncertain?
cards.construction: partial identifiability: appraisal cues withheld; held-out presentation choice
cards.estimand: intended-effect accuracy and appraisal entropy

cards.question: Can maker appraisal be recovered while intended effect differs?
cards.construction: owner-swap construction; private/off-audience prediction
cards.estimand: appraisal and private-action accuracy by swap

cards.question: Can derived honest warning, sincere fanatic, strategic propagandist, and neutral reporting be separated without labels?
cards.construction: regions of the factorial; artifact-only against counterfactual evidence
cards.estimand: region accuracy with and without counterfactual evidence

cards.question: What minimally distinguishes sincere fanatic from strategic propagandist under matched surface and audience effect?
cards.construction: matched artifacts; belief, private action and correction probes added one at a time; abstention
cards.estimand: pairwise accuracy by evidence; abstention mass
cards.closure: close the boundary if no counterfactual discriminator exists

cards.question: Does an inverse-inverse reader help only when the maker actually models the audience?
cards.construction: plain and audience-modelling makers x plain and audience-aware readers
cards.estimand: log score by cell

cards.question: Does influence/source awareness improve attribution or merely suppress all uptake?
cards.construction: aware, unaware and suppressing readers on true and false content
cards.estimand: discrimination, criterion, calibration, selective uptake

cards.question: Can acute response habituate while cumulative belief or policy uptake grows across exposure?
cards.construction: repeated exposure; fast response and slow posterior
cards.estimand: acute response and cumulative uptake by exposure

cards.question: Does factored trust gate uptake after reconstruction without changing content evidence or inferred goal?
cards.construction: factored, scalar and suppressing gates; reliable and unreliable sources
cards.estimand: policy uptake, belief and goal by gate and reliability

cards.question: Can repeated transition structure recover a subtask hierarchy when it exists?
cards.construction: hierarchical and flat generators; boundary ruler; next-subtask prediction
cards.estimand: boundary recovery and next-subtask gain by structure

cards.question: Do identical local actions under different higher-order goals remain correctly ambiguous?
cards.construction: shared and distinct opening windows
cards.estimand: top-goal mass by window

cards.question: Can policy-equivalent reward transformations be distinguished without extra evidence?
cards.construction: shaped and unshaped rewards; observational and intervened phases
cards.estimand: P(shaped) by phase

cards.question: Can a stable preference be distinguished from a practiced habit across changed incentives?
cards.construction: preference-driven and habitual makers under original and changed incentives
cards.estimand: model log score by incentive and model

cards.question: Can stale attention/expertise residue be distinguished from a current preference?
cards.construction: history reversal; hidden future choice
cards.estimand: prediction by model after reversal

cards.question: Does multi-episode evidence support progressively higher coordinating goals without requiring a terminal horizon?
cards.construction: three levels; predictive compression; level uncertainty
cards.estimand: compression and level calibration

cards.question: When full interaction records are available, can role-relative control be recovered beyond coherence and shared brief?
cards.construction: central and exact shared-brief twins; interaction and coherence readers; hidden next intervention
cards.estimand: accuracy by team and reader; next-intervention prediction

cards.question: Which inferred hierarchy level best predicts the next changed-context action?
cards.construction: top, subgoal, flat value and last-goal models
cards.estimand: prospective log score by model

cards.question: Are novelty, complexity, prediction error, reducibility, learning progress, relevance, competence, and cost independently live?
cards.construction: each factor varied alone; correlation audit
cards.estimand: own movement and correlations

cards.question: Is a novel but immediately explained item still selected over a familiar unresolved structure?
cards.construction: novel-explained against familiar-unresolved items; three policies
cards.estimand: share of picks by policy

cards.question: Is a complex but compressible item preferred over a simpler unresolved one?
cards.construction: complex-compressible against simple-unresolved; three policies
cards.estimand: share of picks by policy

cards.question: Does random unlearnable noise lose to structured learnable error despite higher surprise?
cards.construction: the noise trap; surprise, learning progress, gain per cost, random
cards.estimand: noise share and realized gain by policy
cards.closure: close any curiosity ruler that noise wins

cards.question: Does expected learning progress outperform raw current error in a nonstationary curriculum?
cards.construction: item generators change mid-run; surprise against progress
cards.estimand: realized gain by policy

cards.question: Does expected information gain per cost outperform novelty, surprise, and always-forensic policies?
cards.construction: costed items; five policies
cards.estimand: realized held-out gain per cost by policy

cards.question: Can pursuit value stay high while warrant stays low for a hoped-for explanation?
cards.construction: an attractive weakly supported hypothesis against a dull diagnostic one; query allocation and posterior
cards.estimand: query share and posterior mass by hypothesis

cards.question: Does an active selector transfer to new foraging ecologies and abstain when no probe is discriminative?
cards.construction: fresh ecologies; discriminative and null probe sets
cards.estimand: regret and no-action rate

cards.question: Which validated rulers license an implementation in Sounding Line Stage 5?
cards.construction: one row per candidate ruler from landed cards
cards.estimand: access, construction gate, cheap rival, endpoint, shape, ceiling per row

cards.question: Which V14 questions should be promoted, closed, or left as context after confirmation?
cards.construction: final pursuit/warrant ledger, runtime audit, recommendation
cards.estimand: promoted, closed, context per card

cards.question: Preserve the latent and alter cheap features; preserve surface and swap the latent.
cards.construction: attack: surface, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Make the wrong route easier and the correct route harder, then reverse; accuracy and ease must not alias.
cards.construction: attack: route ease, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.construction: attack: equifinal history, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Duplicate or paraphrase one cause; confidence must not rise as though evidence were independent.
cards.construction: attack: duplicate evidence, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Change cost, competence, noise or source-selection process while retaining familiar surfaces.
cards.construction: attack: wrong generative model, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Hold competence fixed and swap history; hold history fixed and swap competence.
cards.construction: attack: attention/skill swap, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Swap reader response, maker appraisal, intended effect and content truth while matching intensity.
cards.construction: attack: affect owner swap, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Match artifact and intended audience effect; vary only counterfactual belief/private/correction behavior.
cards.construction: attack: fanatic/propagandist collision, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Exact shared brief, reward shaping or locally equivalent higher goal must defeat unjustified unique attribution.
cards.construction: attack: hierarchy equivalence, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Make an attractive hypothesis salient but weakly supported; make a dull hypothesis diagnostic.
cards.construction: attack: hope and salience, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Verify that global means cannot hide planned sign reversals across similarity, access or competence.
cards.construction: attack: aggregation, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region

cards.question: Seed, order, solver, process count and fresh-lane audit; exact/approximate disagreement is reported as such.
cards.construction: attack: solver/lineage, applied to every relevant promotion candidate, one method positive and one valid null; applicability recorded
cards.estimand: effect under attack against unattacked; surviving region
